question: According to Census of India 2011, how many districts are there in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**640 districts**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the Census of India 2011, there are **640 districts** in India.
 
• The Census of India is a comprehensive exercise that takes place every ten years, providing vital data on the demographic, social, and economic aspects of the country.
 
• The data collected through the census is crucial for planning and policy-making at both the national and state levels.
 
• The census also helps in the allocation of resources and the implementation of various government schemes and programs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Census of India is conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The first synchronous census in India was held in 1881, and since then, it has been conducted every ten years.
 
• The census covers various parameters such as population size, density, distribution, and various socio-economic indicators.
 
• The data collected through the census is essential for the formulation of policies and programs aimed at the development and welfare of the people.
